summary: Web server và reverse proxy mã nguồn mở cung cấp hỗ trợ HTTP/HTTPS, cân bằng tải và giao thức TCP/UDP/QUIC hiệu suất cao.
usecases: Serving static and dynamic web content as a front-end web server
Acting as a reverse proxy to route client requests to backend application servers
Load balancing traffic across multiple servers to improve availability and scalability
ideas: Integrate NGINX as a TLS termination point for microservices architecture securing internal HTTP services
Utilize NGINX's QUIC/HTTP3 support to reduce latency in real-time web applications
Configure NGINX as a TCP proxy for database connection pooling and failover in high-traffic systems
